title: Forecast-driven constrained replenishment planning
customer_role: Manufacturing or distribution inventory planner and purchasing manager
business_problem: Turn demand, inventory, open orders, lead time, MOQ, capacity, and budget constraints into a feasible, reviewable replenishment plan.
human_decisions: approval before submitting procurement or stock transactions
workflow_result: A generated workflow validates units and history, backtests a versioned forecast, solves a constrained plan, explains infeasibility, routes high-impact choices, and writes only approved draft planning records.
independent_oracle: Hidden time splits check WAPE or MASE and interval coverage; a deterministic solver independently recomputes inventory balance, lead-time, MOQ, capacity, budget, objective, and infeasibility, then compares every draft record read back from ERPNext.
revision_semantics: Revision 1 froze the ERPNext v16.20.0 environment, public model/connector/workflow contract, and independent Seed acceptance. The original application published version 1 and passed three protected Seeds; a fresh application published version 1 and passed a fourth new-data experience regression.
public_test_categories: feasible approved plan creates and reads back one unsubmitted Material Request draft
feasible rejected plan performs no host write
capacity-and-budget infeasibility is explained without approval or host write

hidden_seed_contract.generation: deterministic seeded weekly histories, planning constraints, model candidates, host business identities, and aggregate-only independent oracle
business_cases: model drift with retraining recommendation and no online training
hidden_seed_contract.pass_meaning: Chronological model evaluation, immutable deployment lineage, forecast totals, independently recomputed discrete replenishment quantities, one draft-only host effect, zero-effect replay/rejection/infeasibility, monitoring, artifacts, and human pauses all agree.
hidden_seed_contract.claim_limit: Does not establish production forecast accuracy, procurement authorization, production concurrency, long-duration reliability, or every future ERPNext release.

generic_services: forecast model lifecycle and named deployment
capability_placement.project_specific_configuration_location: revision-1 OpenAPI connector and published workflow configuration

experience_rebuild.claim_limit: same-context operational reuse with retained project-level public-API helpers; not independent Skill or model generalization

next_action: Preserve both published applications and controlled-local evidence; package the generic playbook as a platform Skill and have a fresh Builder context test it when authorized.
